/bin/bash -lc "db='assets/data/career_path.db'
sqlite3 -readonly -header -separator '|' \""'$db" <<'"'SQL'
WITH RECURSIVE tree(id, slug, name, parent_id, path_ids, breadcrumb) AS (
  SELECT id, slug, name, parent_id, printf('%d', id), name
  FROM career_nodes
  WHERE parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id, c.slug, c.name, c.parent_id, tree.path_ids || ',' || c.id, tree.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name
  FROM career_nodes c JOIN tree ON c.parent_id = tree.id
)
SELECT id, slug, breadcrumb FROM tree
WHERE lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%b.com%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%bba%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%computer applications%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%computer science%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%microbiology%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%biotechnology%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%mathematics%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%physics%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%chemistry%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%botany%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%zoology%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%electronics%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%journalism%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%media%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%fashion%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%foreign language%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%ba economics%'
   OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%commerce%'
ORDER BY id;

/bin/bash -lc "db='assets/data/career_path.db'
sqlite3 -readonly -header -separator '|' \""'$db" <<'"'SQL'
WITH RECURSIVE tree(id, slug, name, parent_id, breadcrumb) AS (
  SELECT id, slug, name, parent_id, name FROM career_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id, c.slug, c.name, c.parent_id, tree.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name
  FROM career_nodes c JOIN tree ON c.parent_id = tree.id
)
SELECT id, slug, breadcrumb FROM tree
WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%computer%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%program%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%software%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%account%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%tax%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%sales%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%fashion%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%journal%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%media%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%biology%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%botany%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%zoology%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%micro%'
   OR lower(name) LIKE '%it consultant%'
ORDER BY id;
SQL"
